sections.name: problem_summary
sections.content: The fictional intake workflow is inconsistent and slow, so the department needs a preliminary improvement plan.

sections.name: findings
sections.content: The fixture reports a nine-business-day cycle time, routing inconsistency, and duplicate entry; the project fixture also establishes a six-week implementation horizon.

sections.name: alternatives
sections.content: Alternative A uses a standardized checklist. Alternative B combines the checklist with an initial triage step.

sections.name: recommendation
sections.content: Pilot the checklist first and add triage where routing ambiguity remains. This is a proposed action, not an authorization.

sections.name: implementation_steps
sections.content: Use the six-week horizon to map the current process, configure the checklist, pilot it, measure cycle time and rework, then revise the workflow.

sections.name: risks
sections.content: Risks include weak staff adoption, incomplete baseline data, and applying a fictional comparison too broadly.

sections.name: cost_evidence
sections.content: Historical cost context is calculated by deterministic engine code from comparable fictional actual-payment records rather than generated by the model.

assumptions: Historical payments are not current quotes
expert_review_needed: Whether the comparison cases are truly comparable
